data.body: **[P2] Do not load source payloads for non-persistent child failures.** `resolveForwardedErrorWithoutOffloading` avoids a target write but still invokes the source offloader. After the parent has claimed early completion, a source outage here throws `PayloadOffloadException` from inside the catch block; the sibling payload catch cannot intercept it, so `runUserHandler` fails the entire invocation for an ignored late branch. Cache the original source-bound `DurableOperationException` without resolving it, deferring any load until a retained future is actually observed, and add an unavailable-source late-child test.
